question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did Mallika prove she was a good friend?
Have you ever lost someone close to you?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Walter may be dead...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But `Mary` might still be alive!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]Mary[/i][/color] might still be alive!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And that means there's still time for her and Ms. Rose to make peace!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now all I have to do is find her...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: At least for tonight, I can stop worrying about what to do and get some sleep...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's going to be another long day alone at the bakery tomorrow, and I'll need the rest!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Actually... I could really use a hand.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I've been burning bread left and right! I don't have time to man the counter!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh huh.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I could work here for a few hours.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? I'm sure Ms. Rose could pay you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm not going to say 'no' to that. My family could definitely use the cash.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: In that case, grab an apron.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Apron?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hehe. I'm just kidding. Thanks for the help!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me! You think every cop loves donuts or something?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll have you know that I follow a strict dietary regimen involving fiber, fasting, and `weekly cleanses.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll have you know that I follow a strict dietary regimen involving fiber, fasting, and [color=#e23b3b][i]weekly cleanses.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've got the colon of a fifteen-year-old... And you want me to eat donuts?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ew...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Donuts? Donuts?! I'm gonna take my squad car and do donuts on your front lawn!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I live in an apartment building.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just... Just give me a sack of unprocessed cornmeal so I can get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Sure... Coming right up.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There you go.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: One day, you punks are going to push me too far...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I can't `wait.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't [color=#e23b3b][i]wait.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa, Kim... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That is...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Exactly what I came in for!
Kim gives the officer a bran muffin.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I can see from your toned biceps that, like me, you're the kind of person who cares about her shape.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, thanks... But I don't actually work out or anything. I just have to knead a lot of dough.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Exactly! You work out as part of your job! I get all `my` exercise chasing dirtbags!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! You work out as part of your job! I get all [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] exercise chasing dirtbags!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's nice to meet someone who understands the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phew. At least I took care of `that` potential disaster.
nodes.text_bbcode: Phew. At least I took care of [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] potential disaster.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, Kim! Wow... I've `never` seen anyone get a compliment from Officer Monte.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Kim! Wow... I've [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] seen anyone get a compliment from Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It looks like you're doing just fine without Ms. Rose's help!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Shoot... This is hopeless...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I can't give up! I'll... I'll just keep walking until I think of something!
A few hours later, Kim finds herself in the town cemetery...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow... I can't believe I walked all the way here!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait a second... Is someone there?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kim! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... I was just on a walk... Thinking some things over. What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I was just on a walk... Thinking some things over. What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's it look like? I'm making etchings of gravestones by moonlight!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Cool.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... What were you thinking about?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well... It's kind of a long story.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We've got two hours until sunrise!
Two hours later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...and she never saw Mary again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's awful, Kim!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know... But there's nothing I can do about it. Walter is dead... Ms. Rose is an old woman... It's too late.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kim! It's never too late!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Mary might still be alive...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And that means there's still time to get her to forgive Ms. Rose!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You know what...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think you might be right!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I kind of want to finish this grave etching.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure... I'd better get to the bakery soon anyway. That bread's not going to make itself.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Mary and I just kept arguing...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: ...You'll see! Walter is going to have plenty of time to think while he's in the Navy, and as soon as he gets back, he'll... He'll...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: He'll never love you! He loves me!

nodes.speaker: Walter's Mom
nodes.text: Girls...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Oh... Mrs. Dodds... I didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Uh... We were just talking about how we can't wait for Walter to come back!

nodes.speaker: Walter's Mom
nodes.text: I'm afraid you'll have to wait forever...

nodes.speaker: Walter's Mom
nodes.text: A man from the Navy came by to see me this afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Walter's Mom
nodes.text: ...To tell me that Walter's ship sunk off the coast of Iwo Jima.

nodes.speaker: Walter's Mom
nodes.text: There were no survivors.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... But it was a mistake, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It turned out that Walter had washed up on the coast of Honshu... And then he fought his way back home!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Kim... Real life doesn't work that way.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Walter died... It was the end of us...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And the end of any hope for me reconciling with Mary.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: The next day, she didn't show up for work... And I never saw her again.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose... I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It's okay, Kim... It was a long time ago.
Later, Kim walks home from Ms. Rose's house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's just so unfair... She's had to carry around that pain for all these years...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And now she's so old... It's almost too late...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Come on, Kim... Think! There's got to be a way to make Ms. Rose feel better!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh dear... They do say that history has a way of repeating.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But I do hope that things go better for you than they did for us...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'm far from okay...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But I suppose I must finish the story now.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: If only to serve as a warning to you...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Sniff... The... The `end?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sniff... The... The [color=#3b78e2][i]end?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Was it something I said?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... I just meant... What happened next?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I know what you said...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You just didn't know how apt a statement it was...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: 'The end'... In many ways, my life `did` end that day...
nodes.text_bbcode: 'The end'... In many ways, my life [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] end that day...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But be warned... There's no happy ending to this story...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It was February of 1945...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Mary and I still worked at the bakery together... But we weren't exactly friends anymore.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Mary! Come quick! The croissants are on fire!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: What was that? I didn't hear you!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: I said, 'the croissants are on fire!'

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: And I said `'I can't hear you!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I said [color=#3b78e2][i]'I can't hear you!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Fine... Fine...
Elizabeth puts the burning croissants into the sink and runs the tap.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: This isn't good... We're barely making money as it is. We can't afford to be burning our wares...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Too bad we don't have that `secret recipe` for our Wonder Bars... We could be making a bundle selling those!
nodes.text_bbcode: Too bad we don't have that [color=#3b78e2][i]secret recipe[/i][/color] for our Wonder Bars... We could be making a bundle selling those!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Ha! As if I'd tell `you` the final ingredient! You'd steal the recipe for sure... Just like you stole Walter!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! As if I'd tell [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] the final ingredient! You'd steal the recipe for sure... Just like you stole Walter!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: How could I `steal` Walter from someone he didn't even like in the first place?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How could I [color=#3b78e2][i]steal[/i][/color] Walter from someone he didn't even like in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: What is it, dearie?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's just...

options.label: This sounds just like me, Mallika, and Spike!
I want to know what happened in the end!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'm afraid I don't know anyone by those names.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... It was your best friend and your boyfriend when you were my age.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh! You mean `Walter` and `Mary!` Why didn't you say so in the first place?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! You mean [color=#3b78e2][i]Walter[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]Mary![/i][/color] Why didn't you say so in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... I kind of forgot.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: So are you just going to forget this story as soon as I tell it to you?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No! I'll pay attention this time! I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh... Walter and Mary. You really were paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I can tell you what happened...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I've lived a good, long life, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I've spent 60 years waking before the crack of dawn, baking, doing what I love...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And I've had the chance to see the smiles on the faces of the customers who come in.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It's been a good life... One of few regrets...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're thinking about something... Aren't you? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It's nothing, dearie...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose... You said you've had 'few regrets'...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But that's different than 'no regrets'.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's that story you were telling me about last week, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Which one?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Shoot... I have to think back to last week! What were the names of Ms. Rose's old boyfriend and best friend?

nodes.prompt: What were the names of Ms. Rose's old boyfriend and best friend?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What were the names of Ms. Rose's old boyfriend and best friend?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh, Kim... You're such a sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: If not for the boost of energy you've brought to my bakery, I would have worn out long ago.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But... You do know it isn't true... Don't you?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh, Kim... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'll try to keep to happier subjects.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait... I didn't mean to make you feel bad...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I just... Don't want to think of you... Gone.
The door unlocks!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nice. No alarm, and Mallika is completely quiet... I `love` the sound of silence!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice. No alarm, and Mallika is completely quiet... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] the sound of silence!

nodes.text: The alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What did you do?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Er... What was the combination again?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... See...
Kim quickly types the correct code into the door, and the alarm stops.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That's better.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are you kidding? This is terrible! Now my mom is gonna know we broke in... And she's going to check the security tapes...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There's more at stake than whether you get in trouble or not!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... But...
Kim slaps Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks. I needed that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Good. Now let's get into that office and try to find Mary's file!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right... And the second number is...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait... What do you mean 'investigate'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What I mean is, all of your mom's patients have `files` full of information!
nodes.text_bbcode: What I mean is, all of your mom's patients have [color=#3b78e2][i]files[/i][/color] full of information!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think it's time we took a little trip to your Mom's office.
Looks like Kim is taking charge of this caper... We'll let you play as her for the rest of this story!
By the time the girls reach their destination, night has fallen, and the clinic is closed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim... Seriously... My mom is `uber`-maniacal about me not looking at people's files.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kim... Seriously... My mom is [color=#3b78e2][i]uber[/i][/color]-maniacal about me not looking at people's files.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Like this one time, in middle school, I looked up Ryan's file and found out he suffers from chronic bed-wetting!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Would you please be quiet and duck down? It's like you've never sneaked anywhere before!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look... We're sneaking in for a good cause... I really want Ms. Rose to get a chance to talk to Mary before... Well... You know.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh... Oh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: When you get to the door, enter the 3-digit code. It's `341.` Remember that, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: When you get to the door, enter the 3-digit code. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]341.[/i][/color] Remember that, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: 341? Got it.
The girls begin to sneak over...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I have to admit, this is kind of fun...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I kind of feel like I'm in a spy movie, and we're totally sneaking into KGB Headquarters, and I'm wearing a cocktail dress...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...and instead of you being you, you're this totally hot guy, and we're going to make out on water-skis, and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's not exactly `sneaking` if you keep talking!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not exactly [color=#3b78e2][i]sneaking[/i][/color] if you keep talking!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now let me just enter that code...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Except... Wait... Now I can't remember it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I can't exactly ask Mallika... I just yelled at her for talking!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Shoot... What's the first number?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay...
Kim logs on to the library computer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... What do we search for?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... 'Mary Bakery 1944'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Er... Okay.
Kim types in the search and clicks the first link she sees.
A disturbing website appears!
Three minutes later, out in the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Who could have known that typing 'Mary Bakery 1944' would end up taking us to a website like `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who could have known that typing 'Mary Bakery 1944' would end up taking us to a website like [color=#3b78e2][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ew... I'm never going to be able to eat cupcakes again...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe the librarian caught us looking at it...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I can't believe she started crying.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe we got banned from the library for life...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now how are we supposed to find out about Mary?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... `Applesauce!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... [color=#3b78e2][i]Applesauce![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait a second. What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What... 'Applesauce'? I guess it's something I picked up from Ms. Rose.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's weird. I just heard another old lady use that same expression today. She's one of my mom's patients.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's a probably a wild goose chase, but maybe we could investigate.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's microfilm?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's like film, but smaller!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's sort of like how instead of CDs we used to have records... The internet used to be microfilm!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Well, without email... Or online games... Or funny videos to download... Or IM...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Anyway, the point is, it's `vintage!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, the point is, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]vintage![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well... I guess we could give it a try.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Any luck so far?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Not yet...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey... Wait a second! Here's an article from 1944!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: 'Local bakery voted as having best buns'!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hehe. 'Best buns'.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait... That one girl in the picture `does` look like Ms. Rose!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... That one girl in the picture [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] look like Ms. Rose!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And the other girl must be Mary.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Cool... At least now we know what Mary `looks` like.
nodes.text_bbcode: Cool... At least now we know what Mary [color=#3b78e2][i]looks[/i][/color] like.

nodes.text: Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That girl looks just like one of my Mom's patients... I saw her outside the clinic today!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You know what this means...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We'd better go investigate.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh wow... Kim looks sad...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess what's going on with Ms. Rose must really be getting to her...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And here I am acting like a spoiled kid, getting all upset about Spike.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look... There's something I want to say.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I do want to be with Spike...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But more than that, I don't want this feeling inside like I'm a bad person.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So... Maybe... We can call a truce?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Maybe Mallika can help you here at the bakery too!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Actually, we're just about to close... I'm heading to the library to do a little... Research.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... Maybe Spike and I can come help.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, actually, I've gotta go get Chip from soccer practice.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But you two girls should totally go to the library together.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It, uh, kind of sounds like you've got some stuff to talk about.
A little later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You do realize that Spike isn't here anymore, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You don't have to keep pretending that you actually want to help me.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... I `do` actually want to help you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But... I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] actually want to help you.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look... My Mom told me about your friend Ms. Rose...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And it made me realize... You're a good person.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So... I don't want us to fight anymore. I want us to be friends.
The girls stare at each other for a long moment...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. We're cool. I mean... I made a promise to myself that I wouldn't let fighting over a boy turn me into a monster.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... We're cool.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yay! Should we... Hug or something?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let's not overdo it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, I really do need to get some research done... I'm trying to find out about a girl in the 1940's... She worked at my bakery... And her name was Mary.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmm... That sounds kind of hard to find...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... Maybe we could try looking at...

nodes.prompt: Maybe we could try looking at...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Maybe we could try looking at...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You... `Love` me?
nodes.text_bbcode: You... [color=#e23b3b][i]Love[/i][/color] me?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You barely even know me.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Do you know my favorite `color?` My favorite `band?` My little brother's `name?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you know my favorite [color=#e23b3b][i]color?[/i][/color] My favorite [color=#e23b3b][i]band?[/i][/color] My little brother's [color=#e23b3b][i]name?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Is it `red`, `'The Assassins'`, and `Barnaby?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Is it [color=#3b78e2][i]red[/i][/color], [color=#3b78e2][i]'The Assassins'[/i][/color], and [color=#3b78e2][i]Barnaby?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's `blue`, `'The Trixies'`, and `Chip!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]blue[/i][/color], [color=#e23b3b][i]'The Trixies'[/i][/color], and [color=#e23b3b][i]Chip![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look... I really do believe that you like me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But it's like you didn't listen to a word I said last time we hung out.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm `way` too stressed out to deal with a relationship right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too stressed out to deal with a relationship right now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And you're coming on `way` too strong!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you're coming on [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too strong!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... It's you, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aw... You don't have to be sorry.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Believe me, I've pulled some crazy stunts in the past when I was crushing on some girl.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Anyway, I really appreciate you coming by...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Mallika... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What do I say?!
Mallika sprinkles a few drops from the bottle onto her hand and rubs it on her skin.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoa there, cowgirl! How much did you use?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Just like four drops.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Four drops! I'm pretty sure that's illegal!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But... Oh well... I'm sure Spike won't be able to keep his hands off of you.
Mallika gets out of the car and takes a few steps toward the bakery when...

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Mrow...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What... What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Why are there a bunch of cats circling around me?

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: MROW!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhh!
Mallika sprints toward the bakery, pursued by dozens of lustful cats!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Mallika. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Why are you so out of breath? And why are there a bunch of cats scratching at the door?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And does something smell like pickled cabbage?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stupid Nicole... That's it! I'm done following her advice!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's time to stop trying to trick Spike into liking me...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And actually show him I'm someone `worth` liking!
nodes.text_bbcode: And actually show him I'm someone [color=#3b78e2][i]worth[/i][/color] liking!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Forget about the cats and the smell, Spike... There's something I need to say.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know what... I'm done with these stupid tricks!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's not a `trick`, Mallika... It's `science!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not a [color=#3b78e2][i]trick[/i][/color], Mallika... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]science![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You bought lion pheromones from a scientist?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, technically, I bought them from Hector, who bought them from Ryan, who bought them from this guy with nine toes who lives under the wharf...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But the nine-toed guy bought them from a scientist!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm getting out of the car now, Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks for trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I have to do this my way.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I... I understand. Good luck in there.
Two minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey... Mallika. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There's... There's something I need to say.
In the meantime, Mallika is getting a checkup at her Mom's office...
We'll let you play as her and see how she's doing.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's see here... Low-energy, sniffles, a general sense of malaise...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Troubling... Troubling indeed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm afraid I'm going to have to diagnose you with a broken heart!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Mom!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: You'll be fine, Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Tell you what, I'm going to prescribe you a pint of ice cream and a girls night out with me!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But for now, I want to go be by myself.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Sure, honey.
Outside...

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Not so fast there, dear...

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Oh, applesauce! There I go again, running off without you.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: I never could keep up with you.

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Oh, hush. Listen to you, still trying to charm me after all these years.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Aw, look at them... They're so happy together!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Who... Who's going to love me when I'm old and wrinkled like that?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've got to make Spike love me... I've got to!
Just then, Nicole pulls up in her car!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Emergency, Mallika! I saw Spike go into Kim's bakery... And he's been in there for three hours!
Three minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So there I was, innocently, uh... `Bird watching` with binoculars across from the bakery where Kim works.
nodes.text_bbcode: So there I was, innocently, uh... [color=#3b78e2][i]Bird watching[/i][/color] with binoculars across from the bakery where Kim works.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've never seen birds near that bakery.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay... So maybe I meant `Kim watching...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... So maybe I meant [color=#3b78e2][i]Kim watching...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Anyway, she's clearly going in for the kill. This is your last chance to get Spike.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm afraid we're going to have to implement `Operation Hot Nostril.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm afraid we're going to have to implement [color=#3b78e2][i]Operation Hot Nostril.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Reach into the glove compartment and get the bottle marked 'Only to be used in case of emergency.'

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What is this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That, Mallika, is a bottle of high-grade pheromones, extracted from a female lion at the height of her potency.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: One whiff, and no guy will be able to resist you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay... The bakery is over there. Put on one dab of that stuff, and Spike is going to be powerless against you.

nodes.prompt: Put on one dab of that stuff, and Spike is going to be powerless against you.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Put on one dab of that stuff, and Spike is going to be powerless against you.

nodes.text: A week later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Er... Can I see your contact lenses for a second?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Why... Whatever for?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's for... Uh... A science experiment.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well... I suppose so.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh my... I can hardly see a thing.
Suddenly, there's a knock on the door.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I wonder who that could be...
The door opens...
And in walks Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Ms. Ro... Er... Elizabeth! It's me, Mary!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: M... Mary?! Could it really be you?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes! Definitely, for sure!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Why... You're much shorter than I remember.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Well... I lost... My feet... In an accident.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: How terrible!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Wait... But... Those are your feet right there.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Those are wooden!
Suddenly, Ms. Rose steps forward on Mallika's foot!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ow! Ow ow ow!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Shame on you... Trying to trick a poor old woman.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It... It's my fault Ms. Rose. I put her up to it.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I thought I could get Mary to come and forgive you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I guess she couldn't forget the past.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh dear... So she really is still mad...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Can I go put some ice on my foot?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Er... Yeah... Let's do that... I should probably get out of here too...
Well... That's no good. You made an old woman very, very sad.
Shame on you... You definitely need to play this again and do better!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Outside...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey... How did it go?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I guess we'll find out soon...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Who cares if she's dying?! It doesn't change what she did!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now you listen here, old lady...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's been over 60 years since Ms. Rose stole a guy from you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And in the meantime it looks like you've made a happy life for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So maybe it's just about time you let this go!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Why, I never...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look... Maybe you don't have the guts to face her...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But if you do, I'll leave her address on this table by the door.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Ha! If she wants to apologize so badly, why didn't she come herself?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, maybe... Maybe she was scared.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean... No offense... But you don't exactly seem like the most forgiving person.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Er... Well... That is...

nodes.speaker: Winston
nodes.text: You do have to admit, Mary, you `have` always been one to hold a grudge.
nodes.text_bbcode: You do have to admit, Mary, you [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] always been one to hold a grudge.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Why, I never...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I... I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That's all I'm asking. If you decide you're up to it... Here's her address...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Psst... Find anything yet?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Only that Ms. Prez needs prescription-strength deodorant...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Come on, Mallika... I need this! Ms. Rose needs this!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait! Here it is... `Mary Mann!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! Here it is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Mary Mann![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Her last name is 'Mann'? Like... 'Merry Man'... Like Robin Hood?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What can I say? She's the one that married a guy with that last name. Don't blame the messenger.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And look... I have an address!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nice going!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now let's go find our `Mann!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now let's go find our [color=#3b78e2][i]Mann![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay... If you promise not to make any more jokes like that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No promises, Mallika... No promises.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... This is the house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Great... I guess I'll just go... Ring the bell...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Gonna do it... Any second now...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Kim... You're brave. You can do it. I know you can.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks, Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay... Here goes nothing.
Kim steps forward and rings the bell.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Oh my... A visitor at this hour? And who might you be?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I'm a friend of Ms. Rose... Elizabeth Rose.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I see... Well, then I suppose you'd best come in.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: So... You're a friend of Elizabeth's, are you?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Probably here to try to steal my man!

nodes.speaker: Winston
nodes.text: Great gravy, Mary! I don't think this young thing is here to...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: You know my thoughts on this matter, Winston! Now leave us be. This is women's talk!

nodes.speaker: Winston
nodes.text: Yes, dear...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I'm here to try to make peace.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Peace, huh? And why should I make peace with that two-timing hussy?!

nodes.prompt: And why should I make peace with that two-timing hussy?!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: And why should I make peace with that two-timing hussy?!

nodes.text: A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay... Bread is in... Oven at 400 degrees... Bagels should be ready in fifteen minutes... Chocolate chip cookie dough looks good...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ah! But I completely forgot about the cinnamon rolls!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll have the usual.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: A customer!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I said... I'll have my `usual!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said... I'll have my [color=#e23b3b][i]usual![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... I think Ms. Rose usually takes your order.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That sounds like an excuse... And the only thing I hate more than excuses are punk kids.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Your usual... I'll get right on that. Here's a...

nodes.title: Secret Ingredient
nodes.subtitle: Can a long-broken friendship be fixed?

nodes.text: It's Friday night, but Kim isn't out with her friends...
Instead, she's over at Ms. Rose's house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hi, Ms. Rose! How was your day?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Perfectly awful, I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Believe you me, Kim, it's not fun to be stuck here away from work.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I miss it. The smell of cinnamon and chocolate, the feeling of my hands in soft dough...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I know.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But maybe this will make you feel better.
Kim opens up a bag to reveal two chocolate eclairs and a loaf of freshly-baked bread.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well, aren't you a dear?
Kim hands an eclair to Ms. Rose.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh my... Dessert before dinner?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But I suppose I might as well enjoy myself while I can...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose...

options.label: You've still got a few good years left!
It's sad to hear you talk like that.

nodes.text: It's a bittersweet ending...
But there's still more to see...
...Providing you can step it up next time and earn a perfect score!
Don't you want to see the bonus scene?
A few days later...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I must say, Kim, it is good to be back at the bakery...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Though I do imagine that nice doctor of mine will be quite upset that I'm not in bed.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Um... Ms. Rose... I think you have a `customer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... Ms. Rose... I think you have a [color=#3b78e2][i]customer.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ms. Rose turns around, and sees...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Mary!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: My goodness... You haven't changed a bit.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Oh, I think we've both changed a bit, Elizabeth...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Which is why I've come here today...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: To apologize.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You're... Apologizing to me?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: You're darned right I am!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I... I was a selfish young thing, Elizabeth.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Sure, you snuck around... But you were in love.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I should have let you have your happiness...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Instead, I blamed you for what happened to Walter...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: But it wasn't your fault... It wasn't anybody's fault.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh... Mary... I've missed you so...
Two weeks later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Kim... How you holding up?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I think I'll be okay.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I could use a few minutes alone with her, if that's okay.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sure thing...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll catch up to you later.
Kim sits down next to a newly-cut tombstone...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I miss you already, Ms. Rose...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know where you are...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I hope wherever it is, your old bones are young again...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... Just wish you were still here. There are so many things I want to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Like... I really `am` friends with Mallika... And that means I'm not fighting her for Spike...
nodes.text_bbcode: Like... I really [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] friends with Mallika... And that means I'm not fighting her for Spike...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And... I want to thank you for that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I want to thank you... For leaving me the bakery!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm going to take good care of it... I promise.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: And you won't be alone, dear...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mary! I didn't hear you sneaking up on me.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: There's something Elizabeth wanted me to give you, dear...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Something we baked together a few days before she died...
Mary reaches into her purse and pulls out a `Wonder Bar!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Mary reaches into her purse and pulls out a [b]Wonder Bar![/b]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is it... Is it really...?!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Our lost recipe.
Mary hands the Wonder Bar to Kim, and she takes a bite.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This... This is the best thing I've ever tasted!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I was walking by the ocean one day, thinking of Walter...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Who knows... Maybe I knew what was coming for him... Call it a premonition.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I dipped my hand in the surf, then pulled it out.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: The water was glistening on my fingers... And I don't know why... I just wanted to taste it.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: And when I did... It hit me... The secret ingredient...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Sea salt.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: After I left the bakery, I never baked Wonder Bars again...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But at least you and Ms. Rose got to eat it in the end...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Yes... It's good...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: But we could have been eating Wonder Bars for sixty years...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Ah... The folly of it...
Mary walks into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose... I won't forget what you taught me... Ever.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I promise...
Kim walks down the path and out of the graveyard...
Soon there is only sound of the waves, beating quietly against the nearby cliffs...
Congratulations... You helped Ms. Rose and Mary restore their friendship!
Great work on earning a perfect ending... We'll see you right here again next week!
A week later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, Ms. Rose... A letter... From `Mary!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Ms. Rose... A letter... From [color=#3b78e2][i]Mary![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: My stars! Let me see that.
Ms. Rose quickly opens the letter.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'll read it out loud...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: 'Dear Elizabeth... I wanted to let you know that I just finished baking a delicious batch of Wonder Bars...'

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: 'They're just as delicious as I remember!'

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: 'Too bad you don't know the secret ingredient!'

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: 'Sincerely, Mary'

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: 'P.S. Tell that awful girl who works for you never to come to my house again.'

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Er... I guess that visit didn't go as well as I'd planned.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I should say not...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I do appreciate your effort to help me, Kim...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But in the future, you might do best to mind your own business.
Well... That was a lame ending.
Come on... We `know` you can earn a better one!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on... We [b]know[/b] you can earn a better one!

nodes.text: You don't hate old ladies, do you?
`Do you?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Do you?![/b]

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!
